title: adina fagifolia

It is a deciduous tree native to tropical Africa, and its leaves, bark, and roots have been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Adina fagifolia include its potential to reduce inflammation, fever, and pain, as well as its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
